name: threads
description: Threads MCP server for Claude Code and AI agents. 30 tools for posting, chained threads, carousels, replies and reply approvals, insights, keyword search and profile discovery.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your Threads profile over Meta's Threads API, which is separate from Instagram's and needs its own token.

Run `npx -y @thenavidm/threads-mcp-cli login` once in a terminal to authorise a profile. That stores a 60-day token at ~/.threads-mcp/tokens.json, this extension picks it up, and the token refreshes itself from then on. Paste a long-lived token below instead if you already have one, but a token set here cannot be refreshed by anything, so it dies on day 60.

Posting is public the moment it runs, so create_post, create_thread, create_carousel, quote_post, repost, reply_to and delete_post refuse to run without an explicit confirmation.

access_token.title: Threads access token
access_token.description: Leave empty if you ran `npx -y @thenavidm/threads-mcp-cli login`, which stores a refreshable token. A token pasted here starts with THQ and cannot be refreshed, so it stops working 60 days after it was minted.

username.title: Threads username
username.description: Optional. Only used for display and for naming a profile when more than one is connected. Resolved from the token when empty.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can post, reply, repost, hide a reply or delete, leaving the 18 reading tools.
